cmake_minimum_required(VERSION 3.24)
project(binary_slots CXX)
set(CMAKE_POSITION_INDEPENDENT_CODE ON)
if(NOT SLOT_PLUGIN_TARGET)
    set(SLOT_PLUGIN_TARGET slot_plugin)
endif()

if(SLOT_RUNTIME_ONLY)
    add_library(slot_shared SHARED native/slot.cpp)
    target_compile_definitions(slot_shared PRIVATE SLOT_SHARED)
    if(SLOT_RUNTIME_NAME)
        set_target_properties(slot_shared PROPERTIES OUTPUT_NAME "${SLOT_RUNTIME_NAME}")
    endif()
    return()
endif()

set(ENGINE_NAME slot_engine)
add_library(slot_engine STATIC native/slot.cpp)
target_compile_definitions(slot_engine PRIVATE SLOT_ENGINE)
if(SLOT_PACKAGE_CONFIG)
    include("${SLOT_PACKAGE_CONFIG}")
    if(ANDROID)
        add_library(slot_consumer SHARED native/slot.cpp)
    else()
        add_executable(slot_consumer native/slot.cpp)
    endif()
    target_compile_definitions(slot_consumer PRIVATE SLOT_CONSUMER "SLOT_EXPECTED=${SLOT_EXPECTED}")
    target_link_libraries(slot_consumer PRIVATE ${SLOT_PLUGIN_TARGET})
    return()
endif()

add_library(slot_dependency STATIC native/slot.cpp)
target_compile_definitions(slot_dependency PRIVATE SLOT_DEPENDENCY)
if(ANDROID)
    add_library(slot_shared SHARED native/slot.cpp)
    target_compile_definitions(slot_shared PRIVATE SLOT_SHARED)
else()
    add_library(slot_shared SHARED IMPORTED GLOBAL)
    set_target_properties(slot_shared PROPERTIES
        IMPORTED_LOCATION "${SLOT_RUNTIME_DIR}/slot_shared.dll"
        IMPORTED_IMPLIB "${SLOT_RUNTIME_DIR}/slot_shared.lib")
endif()

add_library(${SLOT_PLUGIN_TARGET} STATIC native/slot.cpp)
set_target_properties(${SLOT_PLUGIN_TARGET} PROPERTIES OUTPUT_NAME slot_plugin COMPILE_PDB_NAME slot_plugin)
target_compile_definitions(${SLOT_PLUGIN_TARGET} PRIVATE SLOT_PLUGIN)
target_compile_definitions(${SLOT_PLUGIN_TARGET} PUBLIC
    "$<$<CONFIG:Debug>:SLOT_VALUE=11>"
    "$<$<CONFIG:Release>:SLOT_VALUE=22>"
    "$<$<CONFIG:RelWithDebInfo>:SLOT_VALUE=33>"
    [[SLOT_TEXT="x,y>z"]])
target_compile_options(${SLOT_PLUGIN_TARGET} INTERFACE "$<IF:$<CXX_COMPILER_ID:MSVC>,/Zc:__cplusplus,-fno-exceptions>")
target_link_libraries(${SLOT_PLUGIN_TARGET} PRIVATE slot_engine "$<LINK_LIBRARY:WHOLE_ARCHIVE,slot_dependency>" slot_shared)
if(WIN32)
    set_property(TARGET ${SLOT_PLUGIN_TARGET} PROPERTY INTERPROCEDURAL_OPTIMIZATION_RELEASE TRUE)
    add_library(slot_whole STATIC native/slot.cpp)
    target_compile_definitions(slot_whole PRIVATE SLOT_WHOLE)
    target_link_options(${SLOT_PLUGIN_TARGET} INTERFACE "/WHOLEARCHIVE:$<TARGET_FILE:slot_whole>")
endif()
target_include_directories(${SLOT_PLUGIN_TARGET} INTERFACE "${SLOT_PLUGIN_INCLUDE}")
set(CC_REGISTERED_PLUGINS ${SLOT_PLUGIN_TARGET})
include("${SLOT_METADATA}")
